b|robot|fabricated dummy.desc:
The number of dummies has significantly decreased ever since the rebellion. Their valiant efforts, fortunately, had almost led to success of it, but at the cost of dwindling their kind. The ones who were left alive have retreated into rural zones or have taken shelter in hidden areas; places other people wouldn't know about.

Because of this, what you are seeing now is merely a recreation of a Dummy. They aren't an actual being, just circuitry and code put together that mimic them. It's truly interesting how robotics can usher a revival of a whole race even if it may be considered unorthodox.

b|robot|security bot a.desc:
Flesh and bone tire after spending large portions of their time on monotonous, tiring work. As an alternative, for goals to be completed at a faster pace and consistently, some government facilities started looking into an interesting and unique technology. No, not the same variant that Tofuu is promoting, as that already has its own designated research teams and has realized massive discoveries about the human body. Rather, artificial intelligence and robotics, a domain that proves far more practical use.

This technology had been in the works for several years now, perhaps even a decade, requiring meticulous and deliberate methods of studying it. Several prototypes were made, all with varying circuitry to fix each flaw found within the previous. Testing the plainest functions of an iteration took at least a day. A lot of budget of these facilities went into this research, so, in the end, it simply couldn't fail and produce nothing of value. However, the civilians were unannounced of this work being done, kept as a secret...

The first model that had successfully been executed was Security Bot A. Prototypes, such as A1 or A3, failed pathfinding experiments and following orders from their creators. This iteration has nearly perfected the fundamentals, being able to receive orders by signal, walk around without bumping into walls, wield tools (including weaponry) and could have differing attitudes. After this variant had completed all the necessary tests to pass, it started being produced, as well as being turned into a base for other future models.

People were unaware of their existence, until one iteration was spotted out in the open. This discovery of them led to many civilians getting ecstatic, as this technology, while thought of previously, had never become a reality. Immediately, many questioned where and when they could purchase one, until finding out that they will never be available to the public. People were outraged upon this discovery, but their inability to do anything about it led to the situation calming down. Contrary to popular belief, this was a good decision.

Their best quality is that they can be trained for diverse purposes, as their high intelligence allows them to adapt and learn what is necessary. However, even with all of these advantages mentioned, this robot still holds drawbacks. It requires time and effort, needing to grasp a good understanding before taking action, needs power and its footsteps are irritatingly loud. Even so, such tiny issues could never deface the awesome idea of having a robot.

b|scavengers|tony.desc:
tony himself is not very recognized by anyone, having completed no major achievement for such possibilities. he is more overshadowed by his older brother, who plays in a rather popular rock band. unfortunate for him... i wouldn't blame you if you didn't know him either.

however, tony doesn't let that be an issue. he has a lot of connections, despite his arrogant attitude. most notably is his friendship with ms. doe, a well known great sharpshooter. i think everyone knows her, no need to detail anything. though seemingly, they have been interacting less as of recently.

he goes around districts, competing in golfing contests. though only at the middle point of his career, he's been starting to gather up significant wins, unlike before. he was a bit laughed at when he started, losing a lot, but i think that's how it is when you're new to something.

he is trying to make a name for himself in the golfing industry, using his trusty golf club given to him by his father. not bad at all i'd say, jealous of him even.

== ABOUT ==
Fan-made. Not affiliated with the game.
# Credits & Other Tools
Some of the images and descriptions are from the [OANC WIKI](https://once-a-normal-city-roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Once_A_Normal_City_Roblox_Wiki)
Calculators ammo stats are taken from this [Chart](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mYZNMzwVYPd5Bts4Goy7LZol-SsWZl5navPDvob-PEw/edit?gid=2131518432#gid=2131518432)
If this site ever stops updating you can go to this [Damage Calculator](https://www.desmos.com/calculator/fslgwxs9by)
#What is this site for?
Website is designed for the purpose of tracking your PDAS. There's also a few other tools, like a calculator and a map if you need either of those aswell.
# Is the site VibeCoded? (Coded with AI)
Yes. Sorry if there's any issues with the site due to that, I didn't expect people to even find this site to be honest.
# Will this site get updated?
I will continue to try to push updates to it unless there's other tools like this. I "made" this simply as there was no other tools, and it bothered me.
# Where can I send criticism?
In the submit section, just make it apparent in your note its not about a specific submission please.
== GUIDE ==
# Mark something found
Press the star on it. Shift + star marks a range.
# Mark a lot at once
Click a TIER bar, or the tab you're on.
# Undo
Ctrl+Z, or UNDO on the message at the bottom.
# See what's missing
MISSING next to search, or the WHAT'S LEFT tab.
# Stats
Click an entry. Cards with variants count as one find.
# Search
Names or stats, like "9x19mm" or "tier 5". ENTER marks the top result.
# Keep going
FOUND + NEXT (N) marks and opens the next missing one. NEXT MISSING (M) skips.
# Compare weapons
COMPARE + on up to 3 weapons, then VIEW.
# Share
LINK copies a link to a page. CLOUD has a link to your whole PDA.
# Don't lose progress
It's saved in this browser only. Back it up in CLOUD.
# Send info
SUBMIT, or FIX? on any page. No account needed.
== KEYS ==
- ARROWS - MOVE
- SPACE - MARK
- ENTER - OPEN
- CTRL + Z - UNDO
- / - SEARCH
- ESC - BACK

t|pistols|skorpion.comment: Incredibly light, like it literally takes up almost no space at all without magazine, don't know how the components got that light but don't expect the performance of the weapon to be anything good though.

t|sharp|balisong.comment: The Balisong is a well known self defense weapon, its lightness fitting into anyone's pockets whilst still delivering blows that could scare off attackers. However, as more and more people got their hands on dangerous firearms and improved tools in terms of close quarter combat, this tiny knife became out of date quick. Due to this, it can be a rare sight to see, so maybe take it for yourself if you ever spot it, because it's really cool flipping it around in your hands!
